after-eagles-peak.npc: Ah, hello again.  Can I help at all?

options.text: I was just wondering how you got on with those eagles.

steps.player: I was just wondering how you got on with those eagles.

steps.npc: Ah wonderfully.  They're actually most cooperative creatures once they get used to you.  With some rope I'm sure you could find some way to tame them... maybe even fly on them.

options.text: No thanks.  I was just dropping by.

steps.player: No thanks.  I was just dropping by, wanted to make sure you hadn't been abducted again.

steps.npc: No such luck I'm afraid, but I'm sure I'll make another discovery soon enough.  I always seem to.
